desc: The plain statuses on a Hunter's body (scripts/combat/status_looks.gd, docs/STATUS_LOOKS.md). Each status names its look (a builder in the script), its colours (the owning Hunter's ability colours where one Hunter owns the status), `y` (m, where the look sits on a 2 m body; scaled with the Hunter), `size` (scale) and `pace` (animation speed). Every look has its own shape, place and motion, so two statuses never read alike even in grey.

stun.why: any stun: bright stars spinning fast round the head

daze.why: Vex's Daze: a tilted ring of crystals wobbling high over the head

root.why: Meeko's root (her violet): thorns driven into the ground round the feet

gnd.why: Grounded (the Bola, Warchain reel): cords wound round the legs and a down arrow stamping over the head

slow.why: any slow: weighted rings sliding down the legs to the ground

chill.why: Neve's Chill: an ice shell round the body with crystals jutting from it

burn.why: burning (Cinder's Ignite and Ablaze, any burn): flame tongues licking up the body

static.why: Sparkle's Static: teal bolts with a pink core jumping across the body

antiheal.why: Anti-Heal (Kael's Warchain, Sable's Encore): magenta streaks draining up out of the body

sick.why: resurrection sickness: a pale ring at the feet and pale wisps sinking round the body
